argv: set -e; echo @@boot; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; echo @@zones; pack=; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do t=$(cat "$z/type"); m=$(cat "$z/mode"); printf "%s|%s|%s\n" "$z" "$t" "$m"; if test "$t" = sm5714-battery; then test -z "$pack"; pack=$z; fi; done; test -n "$pack"; echo @@pack-temperature; cat "$pack/temp"; echo @@battery; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5714-battery/uevent
